profile_text.body:
xAI is an AI company that describes itself as building Grok, a product it characterizes as a frontier AI model. According to the company's own site, Grok is an AI chatbot with capabilities spanning voice chat, image and video generation, real-time search, and advanced reasoning, accessible at grok.com. The site also references a Grok API intended for developers to build on top of the model.

The held facts confirm that xAI has a tracked presence on theworldofai.org and that Grok is catalogued as a general LLM assistant in the Chat and General LLMs category. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the company at this time.
